title: Eagle Regency Wingback Panel Bed – Upholstered Wingback Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Regency Wingback Panel Bed lifts a vertical panel headboard into a tall wingback shape, and the panels continue down the side rails so the bed reads as one continuous design. It is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Tall wingback headboard with vertical panel detailing
  • Matching upholstered footboard and side rails
  • Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille fabric in 15+ colours
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £311.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £337.99; King (5FT) £349.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille, in 15+ colours. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What makes the Regency a wingback bed?

It has a tall wingback headboard with vertical panel detailing, and the panels continue down the side rails.

Can I get ottoman storage?

Yes. Ottoman gas-lift storage is available as an option. See our ottoman beds for more.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
